name: tea-relay
common: 3girls, garden tea party, round table, passing one teacup from left to center, person on right pouring tea from a teapot into the cup, coordinated hand movements
original: blonde hair, blue eyes, white blouse, red skirt, on left, offering cup to person in center, holding cup by handle, extending arm
brown hair, green eyes, blue dress, in center, receiving cup from person on left, supporting cup from below with both hands
pink hair, brown eyes, green dress, on right, holding teapot, pouring tea into cup held by other people, looking at cup

name: braiding-hair
common: 2girls, cozy room, mirror, one woman braiding the other woman's hair, one seated in front and one standing behind, careful hand movements
original: long blonde hair, blue eyes, white blouse, red skirt, sitting on chair, hands on own lap, looking at mirror, having hair braided by another
short brown hair, green eyes, blue dress, standing behind another, braiding another's hair, both hands holding strands of other's hair, looking at hands

name: helping-up
common: 2girls, stone steps in a garden, one woman helping the other stand up, clasped hands, coordinated movement, full body
original: blonde hair, blue eyes, white shirt, red trousers, standing on upper step, leaning forward, pulling other's hand to help her stand, bracing feet
brown hair, green eyes, blue shirt, black trousers, kneeling on lower step, reaching up to grasp other's hand, rising from ground, looking up at another
